title: Database Developer
tagline: Model data well and query it fast, relational and NoSQL
description: Become the person who designs the schema. Start with SQL, go deep into MySQL and PostgreSQL, learn a procedural dialect, then add document and in-memory stores and the system-design judgement to choose between them.
audience: Developers and analysts who work with data every day

stages.title: SQL
stages.description: Queries, joins, aggregation, DDL, constraints and transactions.

stages.title: MySQL
stages.description: Install, design schemas, index and administer MySQL.

stages.title: PostgreSQL
stages.description: Advanced SQL, JSONB, window functions and extensions.

stages.title: Procedural SQL
stages.description: Stored procedures, functions and triggers with PL/SQL or T-SQL.

stages.title: MongoDB
stages.description: Document modelling, aggregation pipelines and indexes.

stages.title: Data-centric system design
stages.description: Choosing stores, scaling reads and writes, consistency and backups.

seo.title: Database Developer Learning Path
seo.description: Roadmap through SQL, MySQL, PostgreSQL, procedural SQL, MongoDB, Redis and data-centric system design.
